text:
Priya: Quick kickoff — we need to finalize the webinar run-of-show and inbound routing play before Friday. agenda: topic blurbs, speaker order, rehearsal slots, and lead routing SLA.
Tom: +1. Do we have final speaker confirmations?
Jess: Yep — confirmed: Asha (models), Miguel (infra), and Priya (product). All can present live demos.
Miguel: FYI one demo will call the Hosted API, one will call Dedicated. Need clear notes for the ops fallback.
Priya: Good call. For fallbacks: if Dedicated exceeds 90% util, route demo traffic to Hosted with the compat model. We'll mention this in the script.
Tom: For inbound routing — ask sales to tag registrants by company size + intent (trial vs enterprise). That way leads can be bucketed into EDU, AE, and SDR queues.
Jess: Drafted the landing CTA copy: "See Redwood Inference in action — cost, latency, and real demos." Link: https://redwood.ai/webinar-demo-signup (we should A/B test CTA).
Asha: Rehearsal windows — can we do two 45-min slots next Wed 09:00-09:45 PT and 15:00-15:45 PT to cover APAC/NA overlap?
Miguel: Works for me. Can we get infra to shadow the 09:00 slot? we might hit the Dedicated pool. @deploy-bot can you schedule a smoke test at 08:30 PT?
deploy-bot: scheduled smoke test job "webinar-demo-smoke" for 1718604600 (08:30 PT Wed). Status: queued.
Jess: Run-of-show outline v1:
- 00:00 - Welcome & quick goals (Priya)
- 03:00 - Product framing + benchmarks (Priya)
- 08:00 - Demo 1: Hosted API + cost profile (Asha)
- 20:00 - Demo 2: Dedicated capacity + failover (Miguel)
- 35:00 - Q&A + live hot-seat (All)
- 50:00 - CTA & next steps (Sales handoff)
Priya: Can we tighten demo durations to 10/10 max? We want 5–6 mins for Q&A live.
Tom: Sales handoff: set automated routing: high-intent trial registrants -> AE queue (sla 4h), mid -> SDR (sla 24h), low -> nurture. We'll add a hidden form field for "deployment interest" to help signal.
Jess: Need speaker abstracts for the event page. Here are short drafts: 
- Priya: "Why serving matters: aligning latency, cost, and reliability for product teams."
- Asha: "Practical hosted workflows: building demos that reflect production token economics."
- Miguel: "Dedicated deployments: meeting SLA and failover strategies at scale."
Priya: Nice. Can you shorten Asha's to a single-line hook for the registration page?
Jess: Updated: "Asha — Live Hosted Demo: cost and latency tradeoffs in 5 minutes."
Miguel: Ops checklist for rehearsals:
- confirm model versions pinned (prod vs fallback)
- pre-cache common prefixes for demo prompts
- limit concurrency for dedicated pool during demo
- a recorded fallback video if live route fails
Asha: I'll prep a 90s recorded fallback clip that can be dropped into the stream.
Tom: Lead routing doc — I'll draft a simple mapping table and share in #sales later. SLA commitments need sign-off from legal for enterprise tagging.
Priya: Marketing deliverables: hero banner, speaker bios (one-liners), 2 social posts, 1 blog post + benchmarks snippet. Can we have assets ready 48h before the live date?
Jess: Yep, timeline: assets by Mon COB, rehearsal Wed, final run Thu.
Miguel: One more thing — plan a scripted line for the failover: "We're experiencing demo latency; switching to a pre-recorded clip while we restore a consistent experience." Keep it transparent.
Priya: Agreed. Also include a quick mention of the routing policy in the follow-up email so buyers understand resilience.
Asha: Who will moderate Q&A?
Tom: I'll moderate and triage questions to speakers. Can somebody prepare a short FAQ doc for me?
Jess: I'll compile an FAQ from previous webinars and the demo scripts and post it in this thread by EOD.
Priya: Perfect. Last checks: confirm slide decks (5 slides each), speakers upload to the shared drive by Tuesday 12:00 PT, and deck versioning: use filename pattern "webinar_<speaker>_v1.pdf".
Miguel: I'll be on the 09:00 rehearsal to monitor infra metrics. Please send me expected token rates/seq lengths for each demo.
Asha: Sending prompts and expected token counts in DM to Miguel now.
Priya: Thanks team — next sync after we have assets. If anything blocks, @here call it out early. :thumbsup:
